symptom: `revoke create on entity M.E from M.RoleA, M.RoleB, M.RoleC` printed "Unchanged entity access: M.E (M.RoleA, M.RoleB, M.RoleC) — nothing to revoke", exited 0, and `show access` still listed `Rights: create, read` for all three single-role rules (two with XPath, one without); check and mxbuild clean (mendixlabs/mxcli#1499).
cause: Same as #1501: RevokeEntityMemberAccess only narrowed a rule whose role set EQUALLED the statement's, and every partial revoke — entity-level create/delete as well as member read/write — goes through that one matcher. Already fixed on main by fb0cec9c (#1501); #1499 was reported against v0.25.0, before it.
insight: The reporter filed #1499 (create) and #1501 (write member) as separate bugs because the rights differ, and the dedupe against #1225 was right — but the variable shared by both was the multi-role statement over one-role-per-rule grants, not the right. Before fixing a revoke report, check which matcher the statement reaches: every partial revoke funnels into one target selection, so a fix there closes every right at once while its tests pin only the right the first report named. Pin the other rights with their own test; the control is restoring the `sameStringSet` equality guard, which reproduces 0 modified and create kept on all three.
